title: Add FAQ & Help Center page linked from footer

requirements.text: Create a new public page component for “CloudCam AI – FAQ & Help Center” using the exact FAQ content provided by the user, including sections for Subscriptions, Camera & Captures, Account & Login, and Support with the support email shown as text and as a mailto link.
acceptanceCriteria: A new React page exists at a dedicated route and renders the FAQ title, short description, and all Q/A items from the user-provided content.
The Support email is displayed as “infocloudchemai@gmail.com” and clicking it opens the user’s email client via a mailto link.
All user-facing text on the page is in English and matches the provided FAQ wording (including plan details and capture instructions).

requirements.text: Add a new public route for the FAQ page (e.g., /faq) in the TanStack Router configuration so it is accessible without authentication.

quotes: put it a brand new page in the app

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating directly to /faq renders the FAQ & Help Center page.
The FAQ route is not protected by authentication guards (unlike /dashboard, /camera, /my-captures, etc.).

requirements.text: Add a footer navigation link to the new FAQ page, alongside the existing Terms and Privacy links.
acceptanceCriteria: The footer includes a Link that navigates to the FAQ route.
The footer link styling matches the existing footer link styles (consistent hover/underline behavior).

requirements.text: Style the FAQ page to match the existing legal/static pages (e.g., Terms and Privacy Policy) and the app’s current visual system (Card layout, separators, typography, spacing).
acceptanceCriteria: The FAQ page uses the same general layout pattern as existing static pages (container spacing, Card styling, section headers, readable body text).
The page remains responsive and readable on mobile and desktop.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Keep backend as a single-actor Motoko canister; no backend changes are required for a static FAQ page.
nonGoals: Do not implement a Help Center ticketing system or contact form submission backend.
Do not change authentication behavior, subscription logic, or capture storage behavior.
Do not add new billing plans or modify Stripe configuration.
